label: Cuban Collar

profile.distinguishingDetail: The Cuban collar — also known as a camp collar or revere collar — features a wide, lapel-like fold that lies flat against the shirt front with no band, no points, and no buttoning at the throat. It creates an open, relaxed neckline that evokes mid-century resort wear and Caribbean dressing, carrying an air of louche elegance. On bespoke shirts it is typically cut in luxury fabrics like silk or linen, making it ideal for warm-weather evenings and smart casual occasions.
